intro: Our Ogma mattress soothes and supports as you sleep. Responsive pocket springs relieve pressure and minimise movement, helping you drift off easily and stay undisturbed till morning.

features.title: Gentle foam for soothing comfort
features.text: Soft, calming foam hugs you with just the right amount of support, helping you relax and unwind with ease.

features.title: Springs that provide tailored body support
features.text: Enjoy targeted support with individual springs that adapt to your body, relieving pressure and helping you rest uninterrupted.

features.title: Washable cover for easy care
features.text: Life happens, but keeping your mattress fresh is effortless with our machine-washable top cover—just remove, wash, and relax into a cleaner, healthier bed.

features.title: Foam edges provide stability and safety
features.text: Reinforced foam edges keep your mattress sturdy and sag-free, so you can sit on the edge without a second thought.

features.title: Made to match your bed perfectly
features.text: You’ll love how effortlessly our mattress fits your bed frame, thanks to its customisable dimensions.

name: Ogma Queen Bed Spring Mattress 78 X 60 X 6 Inches
